title: A Lantern for the Regiment
author: Ansel Underhill
blurb: Noor Zhou, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must choose which family member gets the last berth before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
